environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled. Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied at mesh level with custom Wasm plugin (compiled from proxy-wasm-go-sdk) that performs metadata sanitization: strips any gRPC metadata key matching pattern 'x-auth-*' or 'x-tenant-*' from inbound requests unless the source principal matches 'cluster.local/ns/gateway/sa/api-gateway'. Additionally, the frontend served by the gateway pod uses Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes on all script tags, with a Content-Security-Policy header specifying 'require-sri-for script' directive, preventing injection of modified client-side gRPC-web scripts that could craft malicious metadata. The Wasm filter binary itself is loaded with SHA-384 integrity verification in the EnvoyFilter resource spec.

config.frontend_csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com 'require-sri-for script'; connect-src 'self' grpcs://api.internal
config.network_policy: deny-all with explicit allow from gateway namespace only
